images are its pre-rendered output.

## Setup

```{r figs3-setup, code=code_for("../script/FigureS3.R", c("^", "Load data")), eval=FALSE}
```

## (A) Spleen standards across experiments {#figs3a}

```{r figs3a-code, code=code_for("../script/FigureS3.R", "S3a"), eval=FALSE}
```

```{r figs3a-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="50%"}
knitr::include_graphics("assets/ExtendedDataFigure3/S3a_MDE_spleen_standard_by_IGT.png")
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Extended Data Fig. 3A.** All-T MDE highlighting spleen standard samples,
coloured by experiment (IGT), demonstrating overlap of standards across
experiments. A standardised spleen preparation was spiked into every
experiment; if a batch effect had survived integration, each experiment's
standard would occupy its own region.
:::

## (C) Surface markers per lineage {#figs3c}

```{r figs3c-code, code=code_for("../script/FigureS3.R", "S3c"), eval=FALSE}
```

```{r figs3c-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="100%"}
knitr::include_graphics(c(
  "assets/ExtendedDataFigure3/S3c_FeatureScatter_TCRB_TCRGD_bylineage.png",

  "assets/ExtendedDataFigure3/S3c_FeatureScatter_CD8A_CD8B_bylineage.png"))
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Extended Data Fig. 3C.** Expression of TCRγδ versus TCRβ, CD4 versus CD8β and
CD8β versus CD8α (CITE-seq, log1p(CP10K)) shown separately for each T-cell
lineage. Dashed lines mark the protein positivity thresholds.
:::

## (D, E) Invariant-TCR populations {#figs3de}

```{r figs3de-code, code=code_for("../script/FigureS3.R", "S3d/S3e"), eval=FALSE}
```

```{r figs3de-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="45%"}
knitr::include_graphics(c("assets/ExtendedDataFigure3/S3d_MDE_iNKT.png",
                          "assets/ExtendedDataFigure3/S3e_MDE_MAIT.png"))
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Extended Data Fig. 3D, E.** **D**: all-T MDE with iNKT cells identified by
their canonical invariant TCR, defined by TRAV11–TRAJ18 usage and characteristic
CDR3α junction sequences (CVVGDRGSALGRLHF, CVVADRGSALGRLHF, CVVVDRGSALGRLHF).
**E**: all-T MDE with MAIT cells identified by their canonical TCR, defined by
TRAV1–TRAJ33 usage with a characteristic CDR3α length of 12 amino acids. Both
populations are called from TCR sequence alone, with no reference to the
transcriptome.
:::

```{r figs3f-code, code=code_for("../script/FigureS3.R", "S3f"), eval=FALSE}

```

::: {.figcaption}
**Extended Data Fig. 3F.** All-T MDE highlighting proliferating cells (black)
and miniverse (wM) cells (red). Both groups draw cells from every lineage.
:::
